trigger: The frozen confirmatory audit exposed a generic Meson false-positive class: a bare successful Meson Ok summary can describe excluded lint or packaging-validation-only actions.
construct_defect: L_MESON_OK required only a positive Meson summary count and did not require evidence that the successful item was a qualifying behavioral test. The audited validate-metainfo task is excluded by qualifying-actions-v1.0.0.
prospective_correction: Replace the bare summary rule with L_MESON_NAMED_TEST_OK, which requires a completed named test/spec/unit/integration item and a nonzero Meson summary in the same transcript.
fixture_policy: The former bare-summary positive fixture is now adversarial-negative; named behavioral-test and validate-metainfo fixtures were added.
scope: Generic rule amendment applied to the complete 200-project sample; no package-specific override and no outcome-proportion criterion was used.
complete_rerun_result: One generic false-positive state changed to L_NO_POSITIVE_EXECUTION_EVIDENCE; one independently positive transcript retained L_EXECUTION_EVIDENCED through qualifying Meson/TAP evidence.
